lines.text: Where on earth did I put my reptile encyclopedia?
I could eat sweets all day long.
A chameleon's eyes look like a pair of lollipops. Isn't it adorable?
Teacher! What do you say we go eat some cake together?
You won't believe what I dreamed about yesterday. A dragon!

You've got to promise to keep this a secret,
but... you give way better hugs than Naga♥
I'm going to look at some pictures of lizards.

Teacher, how long do I have to wait?
Hurry up and play with me.
Whoa! Some new desserts just came out?
I should be able to meet a dragon someday, don't you think?
Think there are any lizards around here who are lost?
I'm happiest whenever I get to eat something sweet, hehe.
Hmm? But I'm still not ready for graduation...
Thanks to you, I'm getting stronger every day.
I feel like I've shed my old skin and been reborn. Thank you♥
You catch on quick, Teacher. I knew you would, hehe.
This is just what I wanted! Thanks!
My heart just skipped a beat♥
You're way cuter than a chameleon, Teacher.
It's weird. Whenever I see you around lately, my heart starts beating like crazy.
You're sweeter than any of the desserts around here, Teacher♥
When can we have a dessert?
Yes?
Any iguanas over there?
Maybe we'll meet up with a dragon!
Once we're done here, we'll finish the day with a piece of cake.
Do you think I can see a dragon today?
I wanna see a chameleon for myself.
Reloading.
Umph.
Done, nice and fast.
Huh? It's already full.
Stay focused. Don't let your eyes wander♥
Let's wrap this up. I'm hankering for something sweet.
Wow!
Clear!
Gotcha, hehe.
Ow...
*Sob*
Stop!
Aw man, I think I overdid it... I'll be more careful next time.
Teacher, let's go have some dessert now♥
Hey, I think a chameleon just walked by?!
Nothing beats dessert in this heat. Care for a bite, Teacher?
I'm so happy we got to come to the beach together!
What are you staring so intently at, Teacher? Oh my, your face is all red! ♥
Naga picked out this swimsuit for me. Isn't it gorgeous?
Getting to see the ocean with you feels like a dream.
Teacher? Where did you wander off to without me? I'm so bored.
You go ahead, Teacher! I'll just be here looking for that pygmy chameleon.
Since I'm already dressed like this, I might as well check out the pool with Naga.
It's too bad there aren't any live lizards around here.
This swimsuit is actually really comfy. Maybe I should wear it every day!
The ocean! And chameleons! I'm so excited!
Whoa... Is this what they call evolution?
I feel much lighter now, Teacher.
At this rate, I might actually be able to graduate!
I always love the gifts you give me!
How'd you know I like this? Thanks!
Teacher! If you keep showering me with gifts, I might start getting the wrong idea! ♥
Just looking at you makes me happy.
I wanna stay by your side forever!
Teacher! I really, really like you. Even more than chameleons! ♥
We're going chameleon hunting, right?
Did you call me, Teacher?
Let's go, let's go!
Let's take a proper look.
Let's finish this quickly and go find some chameleons!
I think I might actually get to meet a real dragon this time!
This place is an absolute heaven!
Aww, it's so cute!
One, two!
I'll be done in a sec!
Teacher! I'm ready.
I wanna live here forever!
Time to wrap this up!
Gotcha!
Whoa! You scared me!
Hehe, easy-peasy.
Hngh...
Ah!
Ow!
Aww... I wanted to play a little longer.
Yay! Now we can go look for chameleons, right?
